# A book whose US dollars all arrived in a borrowing written wholly in US
# dollars, which states no cost and so opens no cost basis, moving 100.00 USD
# between two of its accounts with a 1.00 USD fee in the same transaction.
#
# A transfer sharing a transaction with a fee is refused where the transaction
# touches a cost basis, because nothing in it says which units moved and which
# left. This one touches none: there is no cost basis for the fee to draw down
# and none for the transfer to leave alone, so it is imported as written.
#
# Then 150.00 USD of fees paid from savings, which holds 100.00, takes it to
# −50.00, and the import records the 50.00 it brought in on the owed side.
# usd_moved_with_a_fee_in_a_book_keeping_no_usd_cost_basis_fees_corrected.txt
# corrects the fees to 80.00.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2035-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2035-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2035-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

	type: "Liability"

	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"

	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	type: "Expense"

	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2035-01-05 * "Borrow 500.00 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:USD Chequing 500.00 USD
	Liabilities:USD Loan -500.00 USD

2035-01-10 * "Move 100.00 USD to savings, with a 1.00 USD fee"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:USD Chequing -101.00 USD
	Assets:USD Savings 100.00 USD
	Expenses:USD Bank Fees 1.00 USD

	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:USD Savings -150.00 USD
	Expenses:USD Bank Fees 150.00 USD
